title: Setup leaves simulated heads at the origin
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $t$ be a natural number, and let $i$ be one of the simulated work tapes of $M$. After $t$ steps of the mapping machine in non-forward setup mode, started from its initial configuration on $x$, the head on the tape corresponding to $i$ is at position $0$.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite Boolean Turing machine
i indexes a work tape of M
